name: CommandBars
description: A collection of CommandBar objects that represent the command bars in the container application.
example:
For Each cbar in CommandBars
    Debug.Print cbar.Name, cbar.NameLocal, cbar.Visible
Next

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CommandBars object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CommandBars object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: ActionControl
properties.description: Gets the CommandBarControl object whose OnAction property is set to the running procedure. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveMenuBar
properties.description: Gets a CommandBar object that represents the active menu bar in the container application. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a count of the number of command bars in the host application. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayTooltips
properties.description: Is True if ScreenTips are displayed whenever the user positions the pointer over command bar controls. Read/write.

properties.name: DisplayKeysInTooltips
properties.description: Is True if shortcut keys are displayed in the ToolTips for each command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a CommandBar object from the CommandBars collection. Read-only.

properties.name: LargeButtons
properties.description: Is True if the toolbar buttons displayed are larger than normal size. Read/write.

properties.name: MenuAnimationStyle
properties.description: Gets or sets a MsoMenuAnimation that represents the way a command bar is animated. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CommandBars object. Read-only.

properties.name: AdaptiveMenus
properties.description: This property checks or unchecks the check box control for the option to show menus in Microsoft Office as full or personalized. Read/write.

properties.name: DisplayFonts
properties.description: Is True if the font names in the Font box are displayed in their actual fonts. Read/write.

properties.name: DisableCustomize
properties.description: Is True if toolbar customization is disabled. Read/write.

properties.name: DisableAskAQuestionDropdown
properties.description: Is True if the Answer Wizard dropdown menu is enabled. Read/write.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([Name As Variant], [Position As Variant], [MenuBar As Variant], [Temporary As Variant]) As CommandBar
methods.description: Creates a new command bar and adds it to the collection of command bars.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the new command bar. If this argument is omitted, a default name is assigned to the command bar (such as Custom 1).

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: The position or type of the new command bar. Can be one of the MsoBarPosition constants.

parameters.name: MenuBar
parameters.description: True to replace the active menu bar with the new command bar. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Temporary
parameters.description: True to make the new command bar temporary. Command bars are deleted when the container application is closed. The default value is False.

methods.name: FindControl
methods.signature: FindControl([Type As Variant], [Id As Variant], [Tag As Variant], [Visible As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Gets a CommandBarControl object that fits a specified criteria.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag value of the control.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: True to include only visible command bar controls in the search. The default value is False. Visible command bars include all visible toolbars and any menus that are open at the time the FindControl method is executed.

methods.name: ReleaseFocus
methods.description: Releases the user interface focus from all command bars.

methods.name: FindControls
methods.signature: FindControls([Type As Variant], [Id As Variant], [Tag As Variant], [Visible As Variant]) As CommandBarControls
methods.description: Gets the CommandBarControls collection that fits the specified criteria.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Is one of the MsoControlType constants specifying the type of control.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: True to include only visible command bar controls in the search. The default value is False.

methods.name: ExecuteMso
methods.description: Executes the control identified by the _idMso_ parameter.

methods.name: GetEnabledMso
methods.description: Returns True if the control identified by the _idMso_ parameter is enabled.

methods.name: GetVisibleMso
methods.description: Returns True if the control identified by the _idMso_ parameter is visible.

methods.name: GetPressedMso
methods.description: Returns a value indicating whether the toggleButton control identified by the _idMso_ parameter is pressed.

methods.name: GetLabelMso
methods.description: Returns the label of the control identified by the _idMso_ parameter as a String.

methods.name: GetScreentipMso
methods.description: Returns the screentip of the control identified by the _idMso_ parameter as a String.

methods.name: GetSupertipMso
methods.description: Returns the supertip of the control identified by the _idMso_ parameter as a String.

methods.name: GetImageMso
methods.signature: GetImageMso(idMso As String, Width As Long, Height As Long) As IPictureDisp
methods.description: Returns an IPictureDisp object of the control image identified by the _idMso_ parameter scaled to the dimensions specified by width and height.

methods.name: CommitRenderingTransaction
methods.description: Commits the rendering transaction. Returns Nothing.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window in which to commit the rendering transaction.

events.name: OnUpdate
events.description: Occurs when any change is made to a command bar.
